action.primaryAction:
=== MASTER PROMPT ===

PROJECT VISUAL STYLE — HARD LOCK:
Premium stylized theatrical 3D animation. Clearly animated characters and environments. No photorealistic CGI, realistic digital humans, or live-action skin texture. South Bronx, 2076. Maintain the exact established Zeke Zoom visual universe.

XPERT — ZEKE ZOOM 2076
BOOK IMAGE 4 — “FAMILY CHILD LABOR”

TASK:
Create ONE optimized Runway IMAGE-generation prompt for Book Image 4.

HARD OUTPUT RULE:
Final Xpert output MUST be under 3,500 characters.
Output ONLY the final Runway prompt.
Do NOT append compressed versions, asset lists, continuity notes, duplicate negatives, summaries, explanations, or repeated canon.

STORY PURPOSE:
Introduce Zeke’s best friends Gary and Emory while showing the ordinary, humorous side of Zeke’s extraordinary life.

The visual beat comes from Gary teasing Zeke because a 12-year-old with three college degrees is still sweeping the floor at his family’s automotive shop.

THIS IS A FRIENDSHIP/HUMOR SCENE — NOT AN ACTION OR SUPERHERO SCENE.

REFERENCE PRIORITY — ABSOLUTE:
Use the supplied reference images as identity authority.

REFERENCE 1 — CIVILIAN ZEKE:
Preserve Zeke’s exact approved face, tightly curled hair, medium-brown skin, younger/shorter 12-year-old proportions, relatively larger child head and slim preteen body.

Preserve exact civilian wardrobe:
olive-green hooded jacket,
plain dark T-shirt,
dark blue jeans,
black-and-white sneakers.

NO Z emblem.
NO AEGIS.
NO superhero clothing.

REFERENCE 2 — EMORY:
Emory is the TALL, VERY SLIM boy with the high-top haircut.
Preserve his exact face, elongated youthful proportions, hairstyle, skin tone and established clothing:
orange/brown plaid overshirt,
light neutral T-shirt,
loose dark pants,
green/cream sneakers.

Do NOT shorten Emory or give him an Afro.

REFERENCE 3 — GARY:
Gary is the SHORTER boy with the LARGE ROUNDED AFRO.
Preserve his exact face, Afro shape, skin tone and established clothing:
red-and-black plaid overshirt,
gray T-shirt,
tan pants,
dark sneakers.

Do NOT make Gary tall.
Do NOT give Gary Emory’s high-top haircut.

THE THREE BOYS MUST REMAIN VISUALLY DISTINCT.

SET — ABSOLUTE CONTINUITY:
Use the supplied approved LAMB’S AUTOMOTIVE MASTER SET.

Preserve the established garage architecture, open bay, South Bronx exterior, Lamborghini lift, workbenches, tool cabinets, diagnostic equipment, floor layout, warm afternoon lighting and overall geography.

Do NOT redesign the garage.

SCENE:
Zeke, Gary and Emory are together inside Lamb’s Automotive during the same Saturday sequence.

Zeke has paused while sweeping and still has the broom with him.

Gary is playfully teasing Zeke about having three college degrees while still sweeping floors. His body language should be animated, amused and friendly — perhaps gesturing toward Zeke or the broom while grinning.

Zeke reacts with an amused, mildly annoyed “really?” expression. He is comfortable with his friends, not angry or embarrassed.

Emory stands nearby with his characteristic dry, matter-of-fact demeanor, naturally participating in the conversation without exaggerated comedy.

Their friendship should be instantly readable.

Do NOT put dialogue or speech bubbles in the image.

COMPOSITION:
Premium animated-feature medium-wide three-character shot.

Zeke is the visual anchor.
Gary and Emory form a natural conversational triangle around him.

The broom must remain clearly visible and understandable as the subject of the joke.

Show the boys at sufficiently full scale to emphasize the height contrast:
Zeke = short/young,
Gary = shorter boy with Afro,
Emory = clearly tallest and very slim.

Keep enough of Lamb’s Automotive visible to maintain location continuity without allowing the environment to overpower the characters.

Natural child-scale camera height.
Strong foreground/midground/background separation.
Feature-film composition and dimensional depth.

LIGHTING:
Match established warm late-afternoon sunlight through the garage bay mixed with practical shop lighting. Preserve the visual continuity of previous Lamb’s Automotive illustrations.

MOOD:
Warm, funny, affectionate, intelligent and grounded.
Three real best friends joking around on a normal Saturday.

STYLE:
Premium theatrical stylized 3D animated feature-film frame matching the approved Zeke canon.

NOT photorealistic.
NOT live action.
NOT 2D.
NOT concept art.
NOT game/Unreal CGI.
NOT cyberpunk.

FORBIDDEN:
Character redesigns, swapped identities, altered hairstyles, wrong heights, wardrobe changes, older-looking boys, adult proportions, muscular children, Z emblem, AEGIS, superhero imagery, dialogue text, speech bubbles, extra characters, duplicate boys, garage redesign, different Lamborghini, excessive futuristic technology or random generated text.

CONTINUITY IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN NOVELTY.

FINAL GOAL:
A warm cinematic friendship moment introducing Gary and Emory: brilliant 12-year-old Zeke stands with his broom inside his family’s automotive shop while Gary jokingly teases him and tall, dry-humored Emory joins the exchange.
